title: Hide the sidebars on DEV
question: How do I read dev.to without the sidebars?
answer: Logged out, DEV shows a left and a right sidebar on the home feed and on articles, and there is no switch to hide them. The usermods script on this page hides both: the navigation and tag list on the feed, and the reaction buttons and author card beside an article. The feed or article then sits alone in a centred column. Without an extension, narrowing the browser window makes DEV drop the sidebars on its own.
prompt: Hide both sidebars on dev.to and centre the feed and articles.
details: DEV builds its pages on a grid with named sidebar areas (`.crayons-layout__sidebar-left` and `.crayons-layout__sidebar-right`). The script hides both and makes the grid a single column at most 960px wide. On articles this also hides the reaction, comment-jump and bookmark buttons in the left rail; the comments under the article stay. The header, search and the article itself are not changed. The check covers the home feed and an article page.

alternatives.title: Narrow the window
alternatives.body: DEV hides the sidebars by itself when the window is narrow, at the cost of a narrower article column.

alternatives.title: uBlock Origin filter
alternatives.body:
Hides the sidebars but leaves their empty columns. Our check runs the script, not this filter.

```
dev.to##.crayons-layout__sidebar-left
dev.to##.crayons-layout__sidebar-right
```

check.expect: (() => { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('.crayons-layout__sidebar-left, .crayons-layout__sidebar-right')]; const m = document.querySelector('main#main-content').getBoundingClientRect(); return s.length > 0 && s.every((e) => !e.checkVisibility()) && Math.abs((m.left + m.right) / 2 - document.documentElement.clientWidth / 2) < 40; })()
check.intact: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('main#main-content'); if (!m || !m.checkVisibility() || m.getBoundingClientRect().width < 600) return false; const body = document.querySelector('#article-body'); if (body) return body.checkVisibility(); return [...m.querySelectorAll('.crayons-story')].filter((s) => s.checkVisibility()).length >= 5; })()
